items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: Well, yeah, I used to like Alfred

ctx.x: of the desert. And this fella, he used to play at the Ricca Band until he died, Ferret. Ferret. You remember that? Ferret, yeah. He used to wear the apron. Yeah. He was pretty good. Yeah.

And your snare drummers. Well, one of the snare drummers, I used to like Alfred. You're talking back in the old and old. Well, yeah, I used to like Alfred and I was stuff I don't remember if he was a good snare drum player. And this fellow used to play a snare drum with the Eureka Brass Band a long time ago. Well, there were two good drummers there, a good snare drum player, Evo Wells used to play with the Golden Ghost Brass Band, he was a good snare drum player as well. You said Alfred, who he was? Alfred…

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: and after Handy stopped playing with him, and I had Harold. Mm-hmm. Harold been playing with him.

ctx.x: So, who would he have in his dance band when you first joined?

Vernon Gilbert. And me, him, Vernon Gilbert, Tillman. Playing what? Tillman playing bass, you know. Mm-hmm. Bass horn, you know, like he playing the Vernon Gilbert trumpet. You know, clarinet. And, um, well, he had a saxophonian, Handy playing with him. Pretty good while, Handy playing with him a good while. Um, and after Handy stopped playing with him, and I had Harold. Mm-hmm. Harold been playing with him. He was Smitty on piano. And he used the piano, you know what I'm saying? Did he use a guitar player…
That's not the same as Raymond Clifford. No, no.
